<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-aspectj-team"></a>

# Apache Shiro :: Support :: AspectJ – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-aspectj-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-aspectj-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-cdi-team"></a>

# Apache Shiro :: Support :: CDI – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-cdi-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-cdi-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-ehcache-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

# Apache Shiro :: Support :: EHCache – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-ehcache-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-ehcache-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.


## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-features-scm--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access


A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. # Apache Shiro :: Support :: Guice – Source Code Management

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Git use can be found at [https://git-scm.com/documentation](https://git-scm.com/documentation).

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

The following is a link to a browsable version of the source repository:

```text
https://github.com/apache/shiro/tree/shiro-root-2.0.0/shiro-support/shiro-guice
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Git with this command (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)):

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

Only project developers can access the Git tree via this method (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)).

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-scm--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>

Refer to the documentation of the SCM used for more information about access behind a firewall.

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-team"></a>

# Apache Shiro :: Support :: Guice – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-guice-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

# Apache Shiro :: Support :: Jakarta EE – Source Code Management

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Git use can be found at [https://git-scm.com/documentation](https://git-scm.com/documentation).

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

The following is a link to a browsable version of the source repository:

```text
https://github.com/apache/shiro/tree/shiro-root-2.0.0/shiro-support/shiro-jakarta-ee
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Git with this command (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)):

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

Only project developers can access the Git tree via this method (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)).

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-scm--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>

Refer to the documentation of the SCM used for more information about access behind a firewall.

# Apache Shiro :: Support :: Jakarta EE – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-jakarta-ee-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-quartz-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.


<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-tools-shiro-tools-hasher-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Git with this command (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)):

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-tools-shiro-tools-hasher-scm--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-tools-shiro-tools-hasher-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

Only project developers can access the Git tree via this method (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)).

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-tools-shiro-tools-hasher-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-tools-shiro-tools-hasher-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

**Apache Shiro™** is a powerful and easy-to-use Java security framework that performs authentication,
authorization, cryptography, and session management. With Shiro’s easy-to-understand API, you can
quickly and easily secure any application – from the smallest mobile applications to the largest web
and enterprise applications.

# Apache Shiro :: ITs :: JAX-RS :: App – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-integration-tests-shiro-its-jaxrs-shiro-its-jaxrs-app-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-integration-tests-shiro-its-jaxrs-shiro-its-jaxrs-app-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

# Apache Shiro :: ITs :: JAX-RS :: Tests – Project Team

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-integration-tests-shiro-its-jaxrs-shiro-its-jaxrs-tests-team--Project_Team"></a>Project Team

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-integration-tests-shiro-its-jaxrs-shiro-its-jaxrs-tests-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-starter-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Git with this command (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)):

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-starter-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

Only project developers can access the Git tree via this method (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)).

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-starter-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Overview"></a>Overview

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Overview"></a>

This project uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/) to manage its source code. Instructions on Git use can be found at [https://git-scm.com/documentation](https://git-scm.com/documentation).

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Web_Browser_Access"></a>Web Browser Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Web_Browser_Access"></a>

The following is a link to a browsable version of the source repository:

```text
https://github.com/apache/shiro/tree/shiro-root-2.0.0/shiro-support/shiro-spring-boot/shiro-spring-boot-web-starter
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>Anonymous Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Anonymous_Access"></a>

The source can be checked out anonymously from Git with this command (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)):

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Developer_Access"></a>Developer Access

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Developer_Access"></a>

Only project developers can access the Git tree via this method (See [https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone)).

```bash
$ git clone --branch shiro-root-2.0.0 https://gitbox.apache.org/repos/asf/shiro.git
```

## <a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-scm--Access_from_Behind_a_Firewall"></a>Access from Behind a Firewall

<a id="shiro-apache-org-static-2-0-0-shiro-support-shiro-spring-boot-shiro-spring-boot-web-starter-team--Project_Team"></a>

A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions.

The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. The number of Contributors to the project is unbounded. Get involved today. All contributions to the project are greatly appreciated.

**Apache Shiro™** is a powerful and easy-to-use Java security framework that performs authentication,
authorization, cryptography, and session management. With Shiro’s easy-to-understand API, you can
quickly and easily secure any application – from the smallest mobile applications to the largest web
and enterprise applications.

authorization, cryptography, and session management. With Shiro’s easy-to-understand API, you can
quickly and easily secure any application – from the smallest mobile applications to the largest web
and enterprise applications.
